text:
maria: Morning team — I'll be on watch from 06:30 UTC -> 14:30 UTC. Quick pre-shift notes:
maria: - Rolling runtime deploy finished ~02:10 UTC (deploy-bot posted). No errors in smoke tests but keep an eye on cold-start latency for small models.
maria: - Observed a KV cache latency bump in eu-west-1 last night: p50 ~30ms -> p95 ~180ms for a ~20m window around 23:40 UTC. Root cause unknown, likely cache eviction churn.
maria: - gpu-pool-4 had 2 OOMKilled pods between 01:00-01:30 UTC, pods auto-restarted. Node pressure looks transient.
maria: - Nightly embedding-batch job is scheduled 07:15 UTC — it may contend with regular batch traffic, consider throttling if we see token queueing.
maria: TL;DR: watch eu-west-1 KV latency, check gpu-pool-4 node memory, monitor token queue length during 07:10-07:40 UTC window.

aj: ack — I'll leave the watchlist on eu-west-1 and add a temporary dashboard card for KV p95 and eviction rate. :white_check_mark:

developer-bot: Reminder: embedding-batch job scheduled at 07:15 UTC (job-id: ebatch-2026-03-17). See /jobs/ebatch-2026-03-17

devin: can you dump recent pod logs for gpu-pool-4 and paste the OOM traces? I'll triage if it's app-level or node-level.

maria: sure — logs attached below. snippet:
```
kubectl -n runtime logs gpu-pool-4-7f9b -c inference-engine --since=2h | grep -i oom
"Killed process 12345 (python) total-vm:..." 
Eviction reason: memory.low
```

sophie: pinging infra to run a node memory scrub and kernel page reclaim check on gpu-pool-4 nodes. @liam can you follow up with infra ops if we need to cordon any nodes?

liam: will do. I'll also run `kubectl describe node gpu-node-17` and check dmesg for oom_killer entries. If repeated, I'll cordon and migrate pods. :eyes:

aj: added temporary alert: kv-cache-p95 > 150ms for >5m in eu-west-1 -> pager to eng-oncall (P2). If that fires, escalate to runtime team.

maria: action items for my shift:
- (A1) Monitor kv-cache p95 + eviction rate (eu-west-1) — set dashboard and traces link.
- (A2) Keep an eye on token queue length during embedding-batch window; throttle if queueing > 5000 tokens.
- (A3) If gpu-pool-4 OOMs again, cordon node and notify infra oncall.

devin: i'll open a follow-up ticket to add stronger memory limits to the inference-engine container and document expected RSS in the repo. Ticket: INF-1428

sophie: FYI — no scheduled infra maintenance today. Good.

maria: small notes for whoever picks up next:
- If you see sustained kv-cache p95 >200ms, switch routed requests to cache-bypass variant for critical routes (/v1/generate) until we fix.
- Embedding batch run: if it overlaps and causes token backlog, scale the batch workers down by 2 replicas via `kubectl scale deployment embedding-worker --replicas=3 -n batch` (we're currently at 5).

aj: quick CR ping — I left a tiny comment on #runtime-profiling PR, could use a pair review during quiet minutes.

liam: noted. If anything escalates, add me and tag @infra-oncall.

maria: thanks — signing in. I'll post another short update if anything changes. :wave:

oncall-bot: maria took the watch (06:30 UTC -> 14:30 UTC). Scheduled reminders at 08:30 and 12:30 UTC.

aj: thanks — good handover. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving this thread as the canonical shift notes. If you reply here I will see it on rotation."
